name: Sin Fetish Audio
author: Sin Fetish Audio
tagline: Cat Kit + Fox Cut & Sample + Otter Synth, together
description: Three small instruments in one firmware that play at once: Cat Kit (drum pads), Fox Cut & Sample (a sample chopped and played on the keys) and Otter Synth (a small 2-op FM synth). MIDI channels 1, 2, 3 play Otter, Cat, Fox from a computer.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
